title: Initialize a Tote Through the Totes API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client to submit POST InitializeTote with the required ToteId and StationId and add a tote to the system.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when an authorized L2 or L3 support user needs to add a tote to OptiSweep through the live OptiSweep / WCS API.
not_for: Do not use this procedure for Exchange Tote, Exchange Lane, Remove Tote, Get Tote Task, Resend Tote Task, or exchange-setting operations.
Do not proceed when either ToteId or StationId is unavailable.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Open the Apidog / WCS API client, provide the required identifiers, submit POST InitializeTote, and inspect the API outcome.
Review and assist when the request is rejected after both required identifiers have been supplied.

safety_notes: Confirm that the ToteId and StationId are available before submitting the request.
Stop if the API rejects the request or if either required identifier is unavailable.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog or equivalent WCS API client

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client.

steps.title: Open the Totes API area in Apidog
steps.purpose: Access the live OptiSweep / WCS API request used to initialize a tote.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client, open the Totes API area and locate the InitializeTote request.
steps.expected_result: The Totes API area is open and the InitializeTote request is available.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client displays the Totes requests, including POST InitializeTote.
steps.failure_condition: The Totes API area or POST InitializeTote request is unavailable.

actions.label: Open Totes API
actions.exact_action: Open the Totes API area and locate POST InitializeTote in Apidog or the equivalent WCS API client.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if POST InitializeTote is not available in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
Escalate to L3 support if the request is unavailable after verifying access to the WCS API client.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Apidog is installed on the primary servers and the APIs provide data and make requests; the Totes API list includes POST InitializeTote.

steps.title: Enter the ToteId and StationId
steps.purpose: Provide the identifiers required by InitializeTote to add the tote to the system.
steps.instruction: Open POST InitializeTote in the OptiSweep / WCS API client and enter the required ToteId and StationId fields.
steps.expected_result: Both required fields, ToteId and StationId, contain the identifiers for the tote and station being initialized.
steps.healthy_condition: ToteId and StationId are both available and entered in the InitializeTote request.
steps.failure_condition: Either ToteId or StationId is unavailable or missing from the request.

actions.label: Enter required identifiers
actions.exact_action: Enter the required ToteId and StationId fields.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Initialize Tote requires a tote ID and a station ID to add a tote to the system; OCR identifies the fields as ToteId and StationId.

steps.title: Submit InitializeTote and inspect the API outcome
steps.purpose: Submit the tote initialization request and determine whether the API indicates that the tote was added.
steps.instruction: Submit the POST InitializeTote request in the OptiSweep / WCS API client and inspect the resulting request outcome.
steps.expected_result: The API displays the outcome of the InitializeTote request; a successful outcome indicates that the tote was added to the system.
steps.healthy_condition: The request is submitted with both ToteId and StationId, and the API outcome indicates that the tote was added.
steps.failure_condition: The API rejects the request or does not indicate that the tote was added.

actions.label: Inspect API outcome
actions.exact_action: Verify that the API displays the resulting request outcome.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if the API rejects the request.
Escalate to L3 support if the request is rejected after both ToteId and StationId have been supplied.
Escalate if the API outcome does not indicate whether the tote was added.
